name: Stamina
definition: The ability to exert yourself physically over long periods of time without getting winded or out of breath.

benchmark.name: Beijing E-Town Half-Marathon (Humanoid Robot Half-Marathon)
benchmark.model_or_system: Tiangong Ultra (Beijing Humanoid Robot Innovation Center)
benchmark.metric: minutes, half-marathon finish time over 21.0975 km (lower is better); 2 h 40 min 42 s = 160.7 min
benchmark.human_reference: General adult working population, weighted toward workers in physically demanding jobs where stamina matters (construction, warehouse, agriculture). These are not trained runners.
